name: verdict
description: Decides the verdict for one acceptance criterion from what the run and the heal policy produced.

rules.description: The app could not be opened; this says nothing about the feature.
Plain mode: a heal counts if the checks pass afterwards.
A repair was refused by a gate: the app changed behaviour, not just markup.
Failed, then passed on an unchanged retry.
A check failed, an action failed, or a target is gone with no credible replacement.
A repair is waiting for a person.
Checks pass, but a step now causes different API calls or navigation than on the baseline.
Every repair passed all gates and the checks pass.

otherwise.description: Checks pass with the existing locators.
